packages.name: marked
packages.note: Retained browser distribution shipped since MDViewer 1.0. The exact build is committed to this repository and pinned by SHA-256 rather than refetched, so vendoring never silently changes the parser.

packages.name: prismjs
packages.note: Custom build: Prism core plus compact MDViewer grammars for HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, JSON, Bash, Python, Rust, Swift (under 10 KB minified).

packages.name: @highlightjs/cdn-assets
packages.note: ESM common build, lazily imported only when code fences exist.

packages.name: js-yaml
packages.note: ESM build, lazily imported only for a valid frontmatter delimiter.

packages.name: mermaid
packages.note: Official modular ESM distribution (minified entry plus every diagram chunk) so all supported diagram types render offline. The generated transitive notice file covers the complete installed dependency closure.

packages.name: svg-pan-zoom
packages.note: Lazily imported only after a diagram renders successfully.
